name: DataForge
description: Constructing training datasets from the web requires more than acquiring large numbers offiles: candidate records must be judged for relevance, quality, redundancy, safety, licensing, andprocessing cost. These decisions are usually implemented by separate modality-specific pipelineswhose scores are not directly comparable and whose transformations are difficult to audit. Wepresent DATAFORGE, a research framework for topic-conditioned curation of text, image, audio,and relational-graph records.
